_note: Text for the walkthrough clips (issue #48), in ASD-STE100. The caption of each level step is the instruction of its task, from content/projects/. Only the intro clip of the landing page has its own captions. {n} is a number, {title} a level title. 'start' is the first caption of a level clip after level 1; its {n} is the level before.
start: This is your board from level {n}. The new parts come next.
end: Level {n} is done. This is your board now!
still: Press Next to see the next step.

intro.title: How to play Jumper

steps.caption: Put a part on the board. The pop-up shows where it goes, and the good holes glow.
Connect a wire. Tap one hole, then tap a second hole.
Read the pop-up. It tells you what your wire does.
When all the steps are done, press Check. Jumper looks at each wire.

check.passed: All correct! The level is done.

intro.end: That is all. Now you try!
